plan.goal: Compute terrain slope raster from the DEM using slope calculation
plan.notes: Use degree units for slope. DEM is in NAD83(2011) / Missouri Central (projected CRS with metre units). Pixel size approximately 30m.

plan.goal: Create centroid points from building footprint polygons
plan.notes: Generate point centroids for all 6909 building polygons. Retain building id field (bid or ftprntid) for join operations.

plan.goal: Extract slope values at each building centroid using point-in-raster sampling
plan.notes: Sample slope raster at centroid locations. Include building identifiers and the extracted slope value field in the output attribute table.
